thread:
alex: FYI customer Velora reporting 3 missing hourly slices in their usage CSV export for 2026-02-20 08:00-11:00 UTC. Dashboard shows tokens during that window but CSV has zeros.

maria: Can you paste the CSV lines and manifest? Also any export job ids?

alex: s3://redwood-exports/velora/2026-02-20/manifest.json -> includes files, but files for hours 08,09,10 are present and size 0. Sample manifest entry:
```
{"path":"s3://redwood-exports/velora/2026-02-20/08.csv","size":0}
```
Customer says dashboard (console) aggregated tokens: 42,120 tokens across that day; CSV shows 39,000 tokens (missing 3,120).

sanjay: tagging ingest-team @ingest-worker — our worker writes CSVs and uploads. Could be shard rotate bug.

ingest-worker: saw an upload anomaly at 2026-02-20T11:05:12Z — job 58902 retried and created zero-byte placeholder before final file. digging. logs:
```
2026-02-20T11:05:12Z ERROR upload: write failed, created placeholder /part-08.csv.tmp size=0
2026-02-20T11:05:13Z INFO retrying upload job=58902
2026-02-20T11:06:01Z INFO upload succeeded -> /part-08.csv size=3120
```
But manifest seems to reference the tmp placeholder because commit step used stale commit id.

maria: That explains size 0 in manifest even though final file exists? Could be eventual consistency when we generated manifest before rename completed.

alex: Repro steps requested by customer. I ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/exports?start=2026-02-20&end=2026-02-20&customer=velora"
```
Got manifest listing zero-size files. Waited 15m and re-ran, same manifest until I forced manifest recompute via admin UI.

ops_lead: Short term: manual recompute and regenerate CSVs for Velora. Long term: add manifest commit fence so we don't publish before rename confirmed. Filing infra ticket.

maria: I'll coordinate backfill, run recompute job now and send to customer. Alex, can you get customer the corrected CSV and explain timeline + status? Include note that no tokens were lost — only export artifact issue.

alex: Will do. Drafting note.

billing-bot: Alert: Invoice already generated for 2026-02-20 morning run. If CSV changes, we need to check invoice delta and possibly issue credit. Please add billing tag to ticket.

alex: Added billing team and created support ticket #SUP-8921. Will follow up once recompute completes.

ingest-worker: Follow-up: PR to add commit fence opened -> #PR-1234. ETA for deploy: 2d.

maria: Closing loop: recompute finished, customer confirms CSV now matches dashboard. Marking as resolved after billing confirms no invoice corrections needed. :white_check_mark:
